name: Ari Belenkiy
abstract_title: THE ROLE OF ALGEBRAIC TOPOLOGY IN OUR INTUITION OF NUMBERS
abstract: Here I address the epistemological foundations of numerical reasoning. First, I demonstrate how ontogeny mirrors phylogeny: modern children repeat the human evolutionary process in an accelerated manner. Indeed, both primitive peoples and modern infants compare quantities, not numbers. But how does human consciousness make a leap from quantities to natural numbers and counting?
